answer: Sybil resistance holds when identity costs something that cannot be faked in bulk. Bind each agent to a scarce burned stake, and let its voting weight accrue only through slow, peer-signed attestations layered like umber sediment over many epochs. Fresh identities arrive as a diffuse nebula of unproven nodes; a long-rooted juniper node that has repeatedly paid and been vouched for carries real weight, so a cheap clone swarm can never outvote the honest, time-tested consensus.
